MTDI line protocol (5.0)

How any firmware talks to MTDI: one sample per line, ASCII, newline terminated.

KEY=value,KEY=value,...\n

or one JSON object per line:

{"KEY": value, ...}\n
  • Keys: a letter or _ first, then letters, digits, _ . -; up to 48 characters.
  • Values: decimal numbers (512, -3.25, 1.2e-3). No units, no quotes, no NaN or infinity.
  • One line = one moment. Keys that belong to one channel (all axes of a vector) must be on the same line.
  • Reserved keys: _T device time in milliseconds, _SEQ sequence number (MTDI counts the gaps as dropped lines). Both optional.
  • Strict: a line with any malformed field is rejected whole and counted in the Validation Chamber. It is never partly used.
  • Failures: if the sensor cannot be read, print nothing for that sample. Never print a stand-in value.

Inductra Vaion's Uno firmware already speaks this protocol:

CH1=512,CH2=498,CH3=530
MAGX=-1234,MAGY=410,MAGZ=6021

Templates: mtdi_template_arduino/ (C++, any Arduino core) and mtdi_template_micropython/. Check a line from the command line: python -m mtdi parse "CH1=512,CH2=498,CH3=530".
